name: Agentic learning IDE with integrated DOS environment

mentions.name: Agentic learning IDE with integrated DOS environment
mentions.description: This IDE includes an agentic plugin that ablates functions or pieces of code for the user to complete, so learners build toward a working program instead of doing leetcode-style exercises. It can also guide users through bug fixes and other tasks, and ships with a fully integrated DOS environment including a functioning debugger and asset editors. It also works on iPad.
mentions.problem: Provides an alternative to leet code practice by letting learners complete ablated code in a real program while still learning.
mentions.source_excerpt: An ide that has a full agentic plugin that allows ablating functions or pieces of code that one has to complete. So instead of leet code you can build towards a program and still learn something. It can also guide you with bug fixes and other stuff. And it also includes a fully integrated dos environment with a fully functioning debugger and asset editors. Also works on iPad.
mentions.author: yoz-y
